sections.title: v1.2.4 - EditorModalV2 Bug Fixes
sections.content:
# Release Notes

## Version 1.2.4 - EditorModalV2 Bug Fixes
**Released: November 11, 2025**

### 🐛 Critical Bug Fixes
- **Fixed 'Unknown renderer type: object' error**
  - Object-type assets (Team Data, Executive Details, Project Status) now render properly
  - Added 'object' case to RenderFactory (backward compatible with 'objectForm')
  - No Template Builder changes required

### ✨ New Features
- **Central Notification Integration**: EditorModalV2 uses unified toast system
- **Section Complete Notifications**: Visual feedback when marking sections complete/incomplete
- **Extended Notification Types**: Added 'info' and 'warning' alongside 'success' and 'error'

### 🎨 UI/UX Improvements
- HR/divider sections no longer clutter navigation sidebar (display-only)
- Section complete toggles show descriptive success messages
- Consistent notification styling across all modals

### 📝 Technical
- Updated TypeScript RenderType to include 'object'
- Modified 5 files with zero breaking changes
- 100% backward compatible with existing templates

# Changelog

All notable changes to the Executive Summary CMS platform.

## [Unreleased]

### In Progress
- EditorModalV2 production testing and bug fixes (v1.2.4)

### Planned
- Undo/redo functionality (v1.3.0)
- Markdown preview rendering (v1.2.4)
- Expression preview rendering (v1.2.5)
- "Remove all sections" feature (v1.2.4)

## [1.2.4] - 2025-11-11

### Added
- Central notification system integration in EditorModalV2
- Support for 'info' and 'warning' notification types in App.tsx
- Section complete/incomplete notifications with visual feedback

### Changed
- RenderFactory now supports both 'object' and 'objectForm' renderAs types
- TypeScript RenderType updated to include 'object' as valid type
- HR/divider sections filtered from EditorModalV2 navigation sidebar
- Notification type expanded from 'success' | 'error' to include 'info' | 'warning'

### Fixed
- **CRITICAL**: Fixed 'Unknown renderer type: object' error in EditorModalV2
  - Root cause: assetTypeRegistry uses renderAs: 'object' but RenderFactory only had 'objectForm'
  - Solution: Added 'object' case to RenderFactory switch statement (backward compatible)
  - Impact: All object-type assets (Team Data, Executive Details, etc.) now render correctly
- HR/divider sections no longer appear in section navigation (display-only, not editable)
- EditorModalV2 toggleComplete() now uses central showNotification system instead of inline alerts

### Technical Details
- Files Modified: 5 total
  1. `/src/types/schema.ts` - Added 'object' to RenderType union
  2. `/src/renderers/RenderFactory.tsx` - Added case 'object' alongside 'objectForm'
  3. `/cms-admin/src/components/EditorModalV2.tsx` - Added showNotification prop, filtered HR sections, integrated central notifications
  4. `/cms-admin/src/App.tsx` - Updated notification types, passed showNotification to EditorModalV2, added warning/info icon handling
  5. `/cms-admin/public/change-management.json` - This changelog entry
- Backward Compatibility: 100% maintained (both 'object' and 'objectForm' supported)
- Template Builder: No changes required (continues using 'object')
- Breaking Changes: None

## [1.2.3] - 2025-11-10

### Added
- Change Management modal with collapsible menu system
- RichTextRenderer for markdown content via RenderEngine
- ContentModalFixedMenu component for documentation
- System Settings Documentation tab
- Auto-expand active section's parent group on load

### Changed
- Moved to semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
- Changed ContentModalFixedMenu to fixed height (h-[90vh])
- Flattened change-management.json structure (groups + sections)

### Fixed
- RichTextRenderer using correct Design System class methods
- ContentModalFixedMenu sizing and stability issues

## [1.2.2] - 2025-11-09

### Added
- Text alignment controls (left/center/right) for all asset types
- Unsaved changes warning modal with intelligent detection
- Template tracking with base template name display
- Alignment metadata storage (_${fieldKey}_alignment)

### Changed
- Asset Library now starts with all categories collapsed
- Back button styling to match Design System Manager
- Metric cards rendering to use nestedCards

### Fixed
- Object vs Key-Value type preservation on save/load
- Template data loading showing generic examples bug
- Section layout preservation when deleting last field
- List vs listNoTitle label display distinction

## [1.2.1] - 2025-11-07

### Added
- Enhanced nested cards preview in Properties Panel
- Card content previews instead of field names

### Fixed
- Metric cards rendering with proper nested card layout

## [1.2.0] - 2025-11-05

### Added
- Multi-column template support (2, 3, 4 columns)
- Indexed field handling (section_1_0, section_1_1)
- Grid layout rendering for multi-column sections

### Fixed
- Multi-column section import bugs
- RenderTypes metadata handling
- Object/KeyValue schema.fields copying

## [1.1.0] - 2025-10-20

### Added
- Enhanced Properties Panel with live preview
- Asset-specific editors for all 22 types
- Field validation and error messages

### Fixed
- Chart data editor not saving properly
- Image URL validation

## [1.0.0] - 2025-10-01

### Added
- Initial Template Builder release
- 22 asset types across 7 categories
- Properties Panel for all assets
- JSON schema validation
- Dark/light mode theming
- Export/import functionality
- Drag-and-drop interface

### Categories
- Basic Inputs (text, textarea, number, date)

sections.title: ☁️ Azure Deployment (CR-004)
sections.content:
## ☁️ Azure Deployment (CR-004)
**Status:** Pending Approval  
**Target:** December 11-16, 2025  
**Effort:** 26 hours (4 working days)  
**Cost:** $0/month (Azure Free Tier)  
**Full Details:** `/plans/CR-004-Azure-Deployment.md`

### Overview
Containerize backend with Docker and deploy full stack (frontend + CMS + backend) to Azure Free Tier. Enables cloud hosting, CI/CD automation, and publicly accessible URLs at zero cost.

### Phase 1: Backend Dockerization (4 hours)
- [ ] Create Dockerfile for Backend (Node.js 18 Alpine, multi-stage, < 500 MB)
- [ ] Create .dockerignore (exclude node_modules, .git, logs)
- [ ] Update Backend for Production (env vars, CORS, health check /health)
- [ ] Local Docker Testing (build, run, test all endpoints)

### Phase 2: Docker Compose (2 hours)
- [ ] Create docker-compose.yml (3 services: backend, frontend, cms)
- [ ] Create Frontend Dockerfile (Vite build + nginx Alpine)
- [ ] Create CMS Dockerfile (Vite build + nginx Alpine)
- [ ] Test Full Stack Locally (docker-compose up, test all services)

### Phase 3: Azure Infrastructure (3 hours)
- [ ] Azure Account & Resource Group (rg-execsummary-free, East US)
- [ ] Container Registry (Use GitHub Container Registry, not ACR)
- [ ] App Service Plan (F1 Free: 60 min/day CPU, 1 GB RAM)
- [ ] App Services (Backend: App Service, Frontend/CMS: Static Web Apps)

### Phase 4: CI/CD Pipeline (4 hours)
- [ ] GitHub Actions - Backend (.github/workflows/deploy-backend.yml)
- [ ] GitHub Actions - Frontend (.github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml)
- [ ] GitHub Actions - CMS (.github/workflows/deploy-cms.yml)
- [ ] Configure GitHub Secrets (AZURE_CREDENTIALS, API tokens)
- [ ] Test Pipeline (trigger, verify build, verify deploy, test rollback)

### Phase 5: Environment Config (2 hours)
- [ ] Create .env.example Files (backend, frontend, cms)
- [ ] Configure Azure Variables (NODE_ENV, CORS_ORIGIN, VITE_API_URL)
- [ ] Optional: Azure Key Vault (Free: 10k ops/month)
- [ ] Environment Switching (dev, staging, production)

### Phase 6: Azure Optimization (3 hours)
- [ ] Configure Static Web Apps (build, SPA routing, HTTPS)
- [ ] Configure Backend Service (CORS, health check, App Insights)
- [ ] **CRITICAL: Azure Blob Storage** (File uploads, 5 GB free)
- [ ] Optimize for Quotas (caching, health pings, monitoring)

### Phase 7: DNS (Optional) (2 hours)
- [ ] Option A: Use Default Azure URLs (*.azurewebsites.net, *.azurestaticapps.net)
- [ ] Option B: Custom Domain for Static Web Apps (free SSL)
- [ ] Option C: Upgrade to B1 ($13/month for backend custom domain)

### Phase 8: Testing (4 hours)
- [ ] E2E Functional Testing (all features, file uploads, CORS)
- [ ] Performance Testing (cold start, response times, CPU quota)
- [ ] Security Audit (HTTPS, CORS, env vars, auth, rate limiting)
- [ ] Cross-Browser Testing (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari, mobile)
- [ ] Quota Monitoring (CPU < 60 min/day, memory < 1 GB)

### Phase 9: Documentation (2 hours)
- [ ] Deployment Documentation (architecture, process, env vars, URLs)
- [ ] Operations Runbooks (monitoring, logs, restart, troubleshooting)
- [ ] Update README.md (Azure section, public URLs, limitations)
- [ ] Monitoring Dashboard (Azure Monitor, App Insights, alerts)

### Key Risks
1. **CPU Quota (60 min/day)** → Use Static Web Apps for frontend/CMS, monitor closely, B1 upgrade if needed
2. **File Persistence** → **Implement Blob Storage** (ephemeral containers lose files on restart)
3. **Cold Starts** → 5-10 sec initial load, health check pings, document expectations
4. **CORS Issues** → Thorough testing, environment-specific config, preflight handling

### Success Metrics
- Deployment success: 100%
- Uptime: > 99% (with cold starts)
- API response: < 2s (p95)
- CPU quota: < 50 min/day avg
- Cost: $0/month

### Public URLs (After Deployment)
- Backend: `https://execsummary-backend.azurewebsites.net`
- Frontend: `https://execsummary.azurestaticapps.net`
- CMS: `https://execsummary-cms.azurestaticapps.net`
